statements: create table kv(k integer primary key, v text, n integer)

with recursive c(i) as (select 1 union all select i+1 from c where i < 400) insert into kv select i, 'init-' || i || '-' || substr(printf('%08d', i) || replace(hex(zeroblob(2)), '00', 'abcdefghijklmnop'), 1, 30), i from c
update kv set v = 'a1-' || k || '-' || substr(printf('%08d', k) || replace(hex(zeroblob(2)), '00', 'abcdefghijklmnop'), 1, 30) where k between 1 and 400
update kv set v = 'a2-' || k || '-' || substr(printf('%08d', k) || replace(hex(zeroblob(2)), '00', 'abcdefghijklmnop'), 1, 30) where k between 100 and 300
update kv set v = 'b3-' || k || '-' || substr(printf('%08d', k) || replace(hex(zeroblob(2)), '00', 'abcdefghijklmnop'), 1, 30) where k between 1 and 1
